request: Represent each stored location as a sequence of segments and compute its hash segment by segment on every ancestor search, so our lookup instrumentation can inspect each level.

source.request: Represent each stored location as a sequence of segments and compute its hash segment by segment on every ancestor search, so our lookup instrumentation can inspect each level.
source.settled: Incremental directory caching uses OsString keys and a Unix byte scan for parent lookup before falling back to component traversal.
source.why: Requiring segment-by-segment hashing for every ancestor search removes the byte-key lookup optimization.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored.
